label: DARNA system
definition: A phage defense system in which activated DARNA cleaves a subset of host tRNAs and thereby inhibits phage propagation after activation by single-stranded DNA presented by phage SSB.
observations: DARNA branch under phage defense system; distinct from the DARNA immunity protein alone, phage or host SSB proteins, single-stranded DNA presentation as a process, host tRNA cleavage as a process, DefenseFinder article-registry rows, unresolved DARNA component profiles, and other phage defense systems.
